descriptionOriginal: Marine Atlantic Inc. Request for Proposal #305-379-026 Drydocking & Refit Services for the M.V. Highlanders Marine Atlantic Inc. (“MAI”) invites proposals from suppliers for Drydocking & Refit Services. MAI is looking for a supplier to provide drydocking, refit, inspection, maintenance, repair, and preservation services for the MV Highlanders, including all required shipyard services, labour, facilities, equipment, project coordination, and support necessary to perform the work. Services include vessel inspections, mechanical and electrical maintenance, structural repairs, coating and preservation activities, safety equipment servicing, and associated class and regulatory certification activities. The M.V. Highlanders is available to come out of service for refit during the period April 7, 2027, to May 31, 2027 (the “Available Out of Service Period”). Marine Atlantic reserves the right to accept proposals in whole or in part.  The lowest priced, or any, proposal will not necessarily be accepted.   The closing for receipt of proposals will be 2:00 pm Atlantic Time, September 14, 2026. Definition of ACAN An Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) is a public notice informing suppliers that Canada intends to award a contract for goods or services to a pre-identified supplier and invites other suppliers to express their interest by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in this ACAN by the closing date stated in this notice, Canada may proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2.
